name: Sustainability Science & Environmental Studies (GSFS), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Frontier Sciences — Graduate Program in Sustainability Science (GPSS) / Division of Environmental Studies

deadline.value: November 17, 2026 at 23:00 JST (Schedule B application period Nov 11-17, 2026) for the Graduate Program in Sustainability Science (GPSS) Doctoral Program.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: GPSS exempts applicants from TOEFL/IELTS if they graduated (or will graduate) from a university or graduate school where English is the official language, provided an official university-issued document proves this at application. (Note: sister Department of Natural Environmental Studies restricts waiver to US/UK/Australia/Canada/NZ graduates.)
english_waiver.quote: graduate from a university or a graduate school where English is the official language | are exempted from submitting English Language Competency Test Score Reports. In case 3) above, applicants must submit an official document issued by the university to prove it at the time of application.

supervisor.value: Doctoral course applicants at GSFS must contact prospective professors prior to application to confirm research alignment.
supervisor.quote: If you are a doctoral course applicant, please be sure to contact professors prior to application.

funding.value: Competitive doctoral support at GSFS includes SPRING GX (JPY 180,000/mo; JPY 90,000/mo for international recipients from FY2027 + JPY 360k/yr research), BOOST NAIS (JPY 280,000/mo), WINGS TAKUETSU RA (up to JPY 180,000/mo), JSPS DC1/DC2 (JPY 227,000/mo), and RA/TA positions.
funding.quote: Research stipend: 180,000 yen/month (90,000 yen/month for international recipients from FY2027)

entry_route.value: GSFS Doctoral Schedule B requires a Master's or equivalent degree (with Master's thesis/equivalent research submission and summary; bachelor's holders qualify only with >= 2 years of post-bachelor's research via individual screening).
entry_route.quote: Submit a summary written in English of your master’s thesis work or equivalent

notes: GSFS Kashiwa campus Division of Environmental Studies also includes Department of Natural Environmental Studies (Schedule B additional docs deadline Jan 15, 2027) and Department of Ocean Technology, Policy, and Environment.
